name: RCE Capital Berhad
summary: RCE Capital Berhad, an investment holding company, provides financial services in Malaysia. It offers consumer financing, commercial financing, money lending, and shariah-compliant and conventional financing services; financial administrative services; and confirming, factoring, and industrial hire-purchase services in trade-related activities and general trading. The company is also involved in the processing and administration of payroll collection, as well as management services. The company was formerly known as Rediffusion Berhad and changed its name to RCE Capital Berhad in October 2003. The company was incorporated in 1953 and is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
